primary_literature.source: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), arXiv:1507.07949
primary_literature.verified_scope: product density with independent one-dimensional factors of L1 mass one and Linfinity cap one; k-dimensional orthogonal marginal cap, with k=2 cap at most 2 for ambient dimension >2; ambient dimension 2 handled directly by the product density cap

primary_literature.source: Juskevicius-Lee, Small ball probabilities, maximum density and rearrangements, arXiv:1503.09190
primary_literature.verified_scope: multidimensional Rogozin theorem requires finite ambient-dimensional maximum density for each summand; therefore line-supported vectors b_j Y_j in R2 do not satisfy the hypothesis and the theorem was not used for BY

partner_result_applied.application: after the new rank-two cross-averaging theorem bounds the Schur residual by M=2sqrt(2)/(sigma1 sigma2)^(1/2), dependent-square smoothing gives 2^(7/4)|a|^(-1/2)(sigma1 sigma2)^(-1/4) without asserting independence after completing the square

new_results.statement: For R=2 X^T(BY+d)+H(Y), with X two original independent cap-one coordinates, Y arbitrary remaining independent cap-one coordinates, B rank two, and H arbitrary measurable, R has a continuous density bounded by 2sqrt(2)/sqrt(sigma1(B)sigma2(B)).

If a nonzero original-coordinate scalar pivot has a Schur residual containing a two-coordinate zero self-block with rank-two cross block B, then the full quadratic form has an essentially bounded density at most 2^(7/4)|a|^(-1/2)(sigma1(B)sigma2(B))^(-1/4); continuity is not established by this wrapper.
For a=2, Schur residual S_2 with zero selected 2x2 self block and B=I2, and pivot coupling b=(1/20)1_4, Weyl leaves two eigenvalues >1 and one <-1, while the density bound is 2^(5/4).

mechanism_change: Moved from the prior diffuse Schur-residual determinant mechanism to a product-projection plus exact reciprocal-cross-coefficient averaging mechanism; retained the partner dependent-square wrapper only after the new residual estimate.
unresolved_implication: Derive an aggregate or perturbative version from the bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis in the leverage-heavy branch; exact single-minor extraction is refuted.
next_step: Quantify stability when the selected two-coordinate self block is small but nonzero, or aggregate several weak cross maps before paying reciprocal coefficients; test first on the exact rank-three bank family that defeats fixed minor selection.
